milestone: SANRO Chromium AppArmor status lookup correction
root_cause: AppArmor aa-status --profiled displays a numeric count of loaded policies; it is not a list of profile names. See the Ubuntu 26.04 aa-status man page.

implementation.lookup: aa-status --verbose parsed by exact first-token profile-name equality
implementation.failure_behavior: Command failure is distinguished from absence and fails closed. Post-apply uncertainty rolls back only the newly created profile. Rollback verifies absence and never reports success when verification fails.

tests.control_harness: PASS: numeric --profiled output, exact loaded/absent match, prefix nonmatch, aa-status failures before/after apply and during rollback, orphan-loaded rejection, rollback verification, and failed-apply cleanup
